prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for adoption hint, adoption new_screen, choose_path layout, choose_path new_flow, finish layout, and finish redesign, as each has only one test.
Adoption redesign and home new_flow changes proved helpful, each producing a confirmed statistically significant win.
No clear effect was seen across multiple tests for choose_path copy, home wait_info, sign_in reorder, finish new_screen, home notification, or sign_in hint.
Finish notification changes showed no positive wins, with one test causing a severe performance drop that forced an early stop.
Predictions consistently overestimated minor tweaks while underestimating major wins like adoption redesign and home new_flow.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Floating Overlay Screen: Add a dedicated controls onboarding screen before finish showing desktop key shortcuts and pet show/hide gestures. (why: 3 support messages reported confusion on controlling or talking to the pet post-onboarding, and finish stage loses 35.2% of users.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Sign In Delay After Friend Selection: Move the sign_in screen to occur after pick_friend so users establish attachment to a pet before creating an account. (why: Sign in drops 27.1% of users before they get to pick or preview any pet.)
2: [choose_path, copy] Companion Path Value Proposition Headline: Rewrite headline and body on path selection to focus on instant companion setup and zero configuration friction. (why: Path selection drops 23.8% of users with an average wait time of 514s.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Multi-Device Pet Sync Session Hint: Add hint text under sign-in options explicitly assuring users that signing in restores prior pets and saved data. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in with an existing account.)
4: [home, wait_info] Live Desktop Environment Diagnostic Bar: Enable time estimates and status hints on the waiting screen to verify desktop overlay compatibility during generation. (why: 3 support tickets noted pet not displaying on desktop / app not opening, while mean home duration is 2336s.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Companion Summon Audio Alert: Add an audio completion chime and activate background notification when the desktop companion finishes generation. (why: Long wait time on home (2336s mean) causes users to switch windows and miss when rendering completes.)
6: [finish, layout] Split Desktop Welcome Dashboard Layout: Change the final home_intro layout to two_column showcasing desktop hotkeys alongside companion launch actions. (why: 35.2% drop off at finish with support complaints regarding desktop feature misbehavior and control confusion.)
